caption: caption.txt

slides.prompt:
Create ONE finished Harda S2 portrait carousel slide, 1080 x 1350, 4:5. Match the supplied owner-approved LW-CAR-0022 reference for very heavy tight lowercase grotesk headlines, clean regular sans body, italic grey subtitle, flat coral markers and realistic WHITE/LIGHT-GREY anatomy mannequin, bald and faceless, fine grey shading, opaque black #2A2A2A shorts, smooth featureless pelvis, black/grey equipment. Athletic adult male proportions. Use reference for DESIGN ONLY, never its words or exercise content. All non-target anatomy white/light-grey; NO coloured muscles in this carousel. Solid opaque CLEAN #F0F1EB background, no texture or arch. Main type #2A2A2A, secondary #6B6B6B, coral #F26445, empty stars/borders #D6D6D2. Entire top 110px empty for the actual transparent Harda logo, to be composited later at x=48,y=19,size=218x71. Do not generate a logo, brand wordmark, watermark, signature, counter, decorative progress bar or extra text. Preserve exact lowercase, punctuation, spaces around / and +, numbers and hyphens. All text fully visible and never obscured.

COVER, same centered headline/marker/italic subtitle composition as approved reference. Exact lines:
ranking every
gym split
(worst to best)
Very heavy tight lowercase grotesk for first two lines; coral marker behind ONLY `gym split`; regular italic grey `(worst to best)` below. Lower half: one large WHITE/LIGHT-GREY mannequin from the THIGHS UP, FRONT VIEW, holding a small OPEN NOTEBOOK in one hand like a training plan, other hand on hip, confident upright posture. Blank notebook pages: NO readable words, numbers, UI or drawings. Opaque black shorts, smooth featureless pelvis, no colored muscles. No other words or symbols.

fri: `legs`
sat: `rest`
sun: `rest`
